section_summary.extract_value: This preliminary analyses section describes data quality checks and sample characteristics for a single study with an analytic sample of 333 participants. The study assessed body appreciation using BAS-2, along with measures of mindful eating (MEQ), family fat talk (FFTQ-F), and functional body appreciation (FBApS), with BMI as a key variable. Missing data was minimal (4.4%-6.1%) and handled via listwise deletion, and the sample size was deemed adequate for detecting indirect effects in the planned mediation analysis.
